1.1: This Paul—apostle of Jesus Christ, not by my own decision, but by God's will—and I got Timothy, our brother, with me. We writin' to the church of God in Corinth, and all God's people in the region of Achaia too.
1.2: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.
1.3: Big ups to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus—the Father who shows mercy and the God who comes through with comfort every time.
1.4: He hold us down in all our struggles, so we can hold others down when they go through it—with the same comfort He gave us.
1.5: Yeah, we suffer a lot just like Christ did—but guess what? That same Christ pours out comfort just as much.
1.6: If we're goin' through it, it's to help y'all see what it means to endure and be saved. And if we're comforted, it's so y'all can be comforted too.
1.7: We ain't waverin' in our hope for y'all. We know if y'all gotta share in the suffering, y'all gon' share in the comfort too.
1.8: We don't want y'all in the dark about what went down in Asia. We was under pressure so heavy, we thought we wouldn't make it.
1.9: Matter fact, it felt like a death sentence just hangin' over us. But that's when we learned to stop trustin' ourselves—and to start trustin' the God who raises the dead.
1.10: He already saved us from death once, and He still savin' us. And we know He ain't done yet.
1.11: Y'all helpin' too—prayin' for us. So when folks thank God, they know He answered a whole lot of prayers.
1.12: If we brag on anything, it's this: our conscience is clean. We carried ourselves with integrity and God's kind of wisdom, not that worldly fake stuff—and especially with y'all.
1.13: We ain't writin' nothin' you can't understand. What you read is what it is. And I'm trustin' that one day you'll understand all of it.
1.14: Some of y'all already get it—how we proud of y'all, and y'all proud of us, especially when Jesus returns.
1.15: That's why I planned to visit y'all first—to bless y'all twice, really.
1.16: I was gon' stop through on my way to Macedonia, then hit y'all again on the way back, and have y'all send me off to Judea.
1.17: But when I made those plans, was I playin'? You think I make moves just off vibes—sayin' "yes" and "no" at the same time?
1.18: Nah, God is faithful, and our word to y'all wasn't all over the place.
1.19: When we preached Jesus Christ—me, Silvanus, and Timothy—it wasn't "maybe yes, maybe no." It was a straight-up yes in Him.
1.20: Every promise God made? Jesus is the "yes" to all of it. And we say "amen" through Him, giving God the glory.
1.21: God is the one who made us solid in Christ. He's the one who anointed us.
1.22: He stamped us with His seal and put His Spirit in our hearts as a down payment—guarantee we His.
1.23: I'm keepin' it real before God—that's why I ain't come back to Corinth yet. I was tryin' to spare y'all.
1.24: Don't get it twisted though—we ain't tryin' to control your faith. We in this together to boost your joy. 'Cause it's by faith that you stand strong.

2.1: I made up my mind—I wasn't about to come back to y'all in sorrow again.
2.2: 'Cause if I come and make y'all sad, who gon' lift me up? The same ones I made sad? That ain't how it should go.
2.3: That's why I wrote y'all first—so when I did show up, I wouldn't be grievin' over folks who should've been bringin' me joy. I was trustin' that my joy and y'all's joy was the same.
2.4: I wrote y'all in pain, with my heart heavy and my eyes full of tears. Not to make you feel bad, but to show how much I really love y'all.
2.5: Now if somebody caused pain, it wasn't just me they hurt—it hit all of y'all too, even if I ain't tryin' to overdo it.
2.6: That punishment y'all gave him? It was enough. He got the message.
2.7: Now it's time to forgive him and show him some love—'cause if y'all keep shuttin' him out, he might drown in that guilt.
2.8: So I'm askin' y'all: show him y'all still love him. Make it clear.
2.9: I wrote you before to see if y'all would actually be obedient in everything.
2.10: Whoever y'all forgave? I forgive too. If I forgave anybody, I did it for y'all, with Christ watchin'.
2.11: 'Cause we ain't tryin' to let Satan get a foothold—we know how he moves.
2.12: When I came to Troas to preach the gospel, God had opened the door wide.
2.13: But I couldn't rest—I was uneasy 'cause I couldn't find my brother Titus. So I left and headed to Macedonia instead.
2.14: But man—thank God, 'cause He always leads us like winners, marchin' in triumph with Christ. And everywhere we go, it's like we carryin' the scent of heaven with us.
2.15: To God, we smell like Christ—whether folks are gettin' saved or not.
2.16: To the ones rejectin' the message, we smell like death. But to the ones leanin' in? We smell like life. And honestly… who even feels worthy to carry that kind of weight?
2.17: But look—we ain't out here hustlin' God's word for profit like some folks. We keep it sincere, speakin' straight from God, knowin' He sees everything we say in Christ.

3.1: So what now? We gotta start braggin' on ourselves again? Or do we need letters of recommendation—to y'all or from y'all—like some folks do?
3.2: Nah. Y'all are the letter. Written right on our hearts. Everybody can read it—your lives speak for themselves.
3.3: It's clear y'all are a letter from Christ, and we just delivered it. But this letter ain't written with ink—it's written by the Spirit of the living God. Not on stone tablets, but on hearts—real flesh, real love, real change.
3.4: We got this confidence in God because of Christ.
3.5: Not because we think we got it all together by ourselves. Nah—our ability comes from God.
3.6: He's the one who made us fit to serve under the new covenant—not by the letter of the law, but by the Spirit. 'Cause the letter? That kills. But the Spirit? She gives life.
3.7: If the old ministry—written on stone and connected to death—came with glory (so much so that folks couldn't even look at Moses' face 'cause it was glowing),
3.8: then how much more glorious is this new ministry led by the Spirit?
3.9: That old law brought condemnation and still had some glory… But this new ministry? The one rooted in righteousness? Way more glorious.
3.10: Honestly, compared to this new glory, that old one don't even shine the same.
3.11: If what was temporary had glory, how much more glory is in what lasts forever?
3.12: Since we got this kind of hope, we speak bold.
3.13: Not like Moses, who had to cover his face 'cause the shine was fading.
3.14: But the folks back then? Their minds were stuck—blinded. And to this day, when they read the old law, it's like they still wearin' that same veil. Only Christ can take it off.
3.15: Even now, when the old ways are read, a veil's still sittin' on their heart.
3.16: But when you turn to the Lord? That veil comes off.
3.17: And the Lord is Spirit—and where the Spirit of the Lord is? There's freedom.
3.18: And now, all of us with the veil gone—we lookin' straight at God's glory, like a reflection in a mirror. And we bein' transformed—from glory to glory, level to level, all through the power of the Spirit.

4.1: So, since God gave us this ministry and showed us mercy—we ain't foldin'. We not givin' up.
4.2: We don't play dirty. We don't move in secret shame. We don't twist Scripture or hustle God's Word. Nah—we keep it 100 and let the truth speak for itself, before God and everybody's conscience.
4.3: Now if this gospel still feel like it's covered up, it's only hid from folks who ain't tryna make it—they perishing.
4.4: The enemy, the so-called god of this world, got they minds blinded. They don't believe, so they can't even see the light—the light that shows the glory of Christ, who's the image of God Himself.
4.5: We ain't preachin' about ourselves—we preachin' Jesus Christ as Lord, and we just here to serve y'all for His sake.
4.6: Same God who said, "Let there be light," back in Genesis? He lit us up too. He put that light in our hearts—so we could shine with the knowledge of God's glory, seen clear in Jesus' face.
4.7: But check this—we carry this treasure in clay jars (that's us). Why? So folks see that the power ain't from us, but straight from God.
4.8: We pressed on every side—but we ain't crushed. We confused sometimes—but we ain't givin' up.
4.9: We get hated on—but we ain't alone. We get knocked down—but we ain't knocked out.
4.10: We carry Jesus' death in our bodies, so that His life can show up in us too.
4.11: Yeah, we live—but we constantly face death for Jesus' sake, so His life can shine through our weak, mortal bodies.
4.12: So while death tryin' to work on us, life's bein' poured into y'all.
4.13: We got that same spirit of faith like the Scripture says: "I believed, and so I spoke." So we believe—and so we speak.
4.14: 'Cause we know this: the same God who raised Jesus from the dead? He gon' raise us up too and bring us into His presence together with y'all.
4.15: Everything we go through? It's for y'all. So that more and more folks receive this grace, and gratitude starts overflowin', giving God even more glory.
4.16: That's why we don't give up. Even though this body breakin' down on the outside, the real us on the inside getting stronger every day.
4.17: These light struggles? They temporary. And they workin' for us an eternal, heavy-weighted glory that can't even compare.
4.18: We not focused on what we can see right now—it's the unseen we lockin' in on. 'Cause what's seen is temporary. But what we can't see? That's eternal.

5.1: Look—we know if this earthly body we livin' in (this tent) gets taken down, we got a real home waitin' on us. A building from God, not made by human hands—eternal and in heaven.
5.2: While we're still in this body, we groan—we long to be covered in that heavenly outfit.
5.3: 'Cause when we put on that eternal body, we won't be out here spiritually naked.
5.4: These earthly bodies got us groanin' under pressure—not 'cause we wanna die, but 'cause we ready for that forever upgrade, where life swallows up death completely.
5.5: And the One who prepped us for all this? God. And He gave us the Holy Spirit as our down payment—a guarantee that He's comin' back for us.
5.6: That's why we stay confident—even though we know that as long as we're here in this body, we ain't fully home with the Lord yet.
5.7: We don't walk by what we see—we walk by faith.
5.8: But trust—we would love to leave this body and finally be at home with the Lord.
5.9: So whether we're here in the body or with Him, we make it our goal to please Him.
5.10: 'Cause everybody—all of us—gon' have to stand before Christ's judgment seat, and give account for what we did while we was livin' in these bodies—good or bad.
5.11: Since we know the weight of standin' before God, we try to persuade folks with love and truth. God sees our hearts, and I hope y'all do too.
5.12: We ain't out here tryna promote ourselves again—we just givin' y'all a reason to speak up for us, especially against folks who brag on looks and not on what's really in the heart.
5.13: If we actin' a little extra, it's for God. If we got our minds right, it's for y'all.
5.14: It's Christ's love that keeps us movin'—'cause we believe this: if Jesus died for everybody, then in Him, we all died too.
5.15: And since He died for us, we ain't supposed to live for ourselves no more—we live for Him. The One who died and rose up for us.
5.16: So from now on, we don't judge people by surface-level stuff. Yeah, we used to look at Christ that way too—but not anymore.
5.17: So if anybody is in Christ, they a whole new creation. Old stuff? Gone. Everything about 'em is made new.
5.18: And all this change? That's God's doing. He brought us back to Himself through Christ—and now He gave us the same job: helping folks get right with God.
5.19: God was in Christ, reconciling the world to Himself—not holdin' their sins against 'em—and now He trusted us with that same message.
5.20: So now we out here as Christ's reps—it's like God talkin' through us. So on behalf of Christ, we beg y'all: get right with God.
5.21: 'Cause God made the One who never sinned become sin for us, so we could become the righteousness of God through Him.

6.1: So as folks workin' right beside God, we beg y'all—don't waste this grace He gave you.
6.2: 'Cause God said: "I heard you at the right time, and I came through on the day of salvation." Listen, now is that time. Today is that day. Don't sleep on it.
6.3: We move carefully so we don't cause offense—don't want nobody blamin' the ministry.
6.4: Instead, we show what real ministry look like: Through patience, Through pressure, When we goin' without, When we stressed,
6.5: When we get beat down, locked up, caught in chaos, workin' nonstop, missin' sleep, fasting for real.
6.6: We move with purity, knowledge, endurance, and kindness—empowered by the Holy Spirit and led by real love.
6.7: We speak truth. We walk in God's power. We stay strapped with righteousness—on both sides.
6.8: Whether folks honor us or hate us, lie on us or lift us up…
6.9: Whether people know our name or act like we invisible… Even when we on death's doorstep—we still alive. We get corrected, but not taken out.
6.10: We be sorrowful, but still got joy. We broke, but makin' others spiritually rich. We don't own nothin'—yet we got everything that matters.
6.11: Yo, Corinth! We been speakin' to y'all straight up. Our hearts wide open.
6.12: We ain't holdin' y'all back—your own affections and hangups are what's keepin' you stuck.
6.13: So I'm talkin' to y'all like my own kids—open your hearts back up to us.
6.14: Don't team up with folks who ain't walkin' with God. That's an unequal yoke. What righteousness got in common with wickedness? What light got to do with darkness?
6.15: What harmony does Christ have with Belial (the enemy)? What can a believer and an unbeliever really share on a spiritual level?
6.16: God's temple got no business messin' with idols. And guess what? You are that temple—the temple of the living God. Just like God said: "I'm gonna live in them. I'm gonna walk with them. I'll be their God, And they'll be My people."
6.17: So the Lord says: "Step out from the crowd. Be different. Be separate. Don't touch what's unclean. And I'll welcome you in."
6.18: God says: "I'll be a Father to y'all, And you'll be My sons and daughters." —Straight from the Lord Almighty.

7.1: Since we got all these promises from God, fam, let's clean ourselves up—inside and out. Let's keep growin' in holiness, outta deep respect for God.
7.2: Y'all—open y'all hearts to us. We ain't done nobody wrong. We didn't corrupt nobody. We ain't take advantage of nobody.
7.3: I'm not tryna make you feel bad—I'm just remindin' you how much y'all mean to us. We got y'all in our hearts, for real. Ride or die.
7.4: I speak bold when I talk to y'all. I even brag about y'all! I'm comforted, even in the middle of all our problems. I got so much joy.
7.5: When we first got to Macedonia, we had no rest. We was pressed on all sides. Outside, it was beef. Inside, we was anxious.
7.6: But God—the One who lifts folks up when they low—He comforted us by sendin' Titus.
7.7: And not just 'cause Titus showed up, but 'cause he came back tellin' us how y'all were missin' us, how you were hurt over what went down, and how fired up y'all were to make it right. That news? Lifted me even higher.
7.8: I know that last letter I sent made y'all feel some kinda way. I ain't gonna lie—I felt a little bad… but not for long.
7.9: I don't regret it now, 'cause that hurt pushed y'all to repent. And that's what matters. You felt sorrow in a way that honored God—and that pain didn't harm y'all, it helped you.
7.10: 'Cause godly sorrow? That leads to real repentance and salvation. You'll never regret that. But worldly sorrow? That just leads to death.
7.11: Just look at what that godly sorrow produced in y'all: You got diligent, You cleared your name, You were mad about the sin, You showed respect, You wanted to do right, You got passionate, And you proved yourselves. Y'all showed y'all were serious.
7.12: So when I wrote that letter, it wasn't just about the one who did wrong, or the one who got hurt. It was really so y'all could see how much we care about y'all, right there in front of God.
7.13: That's why we so comforted now—because y'all got comforted too. And on top of that, we super happy 'cause Titus was refreshed by y'all's love.
7.14: I told him good things about y'all, and y'all ain't let me down. Everything I said to y'all was true, and y'all proved it true to him too.
7.15: Now he love y'all even more, remembering how respectful and obedient y'all were—how y'all welcomed him with honor and humility.
7.16: And now? I'm rejoicing, 'cause I know I can trust y'all in everything.

8.1: Fam, let us tell y'all about the grace God poured out on the churches in Macedonia.
8.2: Even while they were goin' through it—heavy trials and deep poverty—they still had joy and were wild generous.
8.3: I'm tellin' you—they gave what they could, and then some. Nobody had to twist their arm either. They wanted to give.
8.4: Matter fact, they begged us—please let them bless the saints and be part of the ministry.
8.5: And they didn't just give money—they gave themselves to the Lord first. Then to us, just like God wanted.
8.6: So we told Titus, "Yo, you started this work—go ahead and help them finish this gift too."
8.7: And since y'all already got so much—faith, strong speech, wisdom, passion, and love for us—don't forget to excel in giving too.
8.8: I ain't commandin' y'all. But I am checking the realness of your love compared to how others stepped up.
8.9: Y'all know the grace of our Lord Jesus, right? Though He was rich, He became poor for y'all—so through His poverty, y'all could be made rich.
8.10: Here's my take: y'all started this good thing last year—y'all was hype about helpin'. That was beautiful.
8.11: But now it's time to finish it. Match that same energy you had at the start—do what you said you was gonna do.
8.12: 'Cause if you truly willing, God honors that. He looks at what you got—not what you don't.
8.13: Don't get it twisted—I ain't sayin' y'all gotta struggle so somebody else can chill.
8.14: But right now, since y'all got extra, let it cover where they're lackin'. And one day, if you need help, they'll return the favor.
8.15: Just like it says: "The one who gathered a lot didn't have too much, and the one who gathered little didn't come up short."
8.16: Shout out to God for puttin' the same kind of love in Titus' heart for y'all.
8.17: He ain't just follow orders—he was all in. He chose to come see y'all.
8.18: And we sendin' one of the brothers with him too—somebody all the churches know is a real one when it comes to preachin' the gospel.
8.19: He was chosen by the churches to travel with us as we deliver this gift—this ain't just about money. It's about God's glory and y'all's heart.
8.20: We makin' sure nobody got room to throw shade on how we handle this generous gift.
8.21: We takin' care of business with integrity—not just in God's eyes, but so people see it too.
8.22: We also sendin' another brother—he been proven faithful time and time again. But now he's even more excited because he got confidence in y'all.
8.23: And if anybody asks about Titus—just tell 'em he's my partner, grindin' for y'all. And the other bros? They messengers of the churches—they reppin' Christ's glory.
8.24: So show 'em you really about this love life. Let the churches see that our braggin' on y'all wasn't for nothin'.

9.1: Now about blessin' the saints with this offering—I really ain't gotta say too much.
9.2: I already know how ready y'all been. I been braggin' on y'all to the folks in Macedonia, tellin' 'em how Achaia been ready to give for a whole year. Y'all's energy got other folks stirred up to give too.
9.3: But I went ahead and sent the brothers anyway—just so all that braggin' I did ain't end up empty. I want y'all to be ready like I said you would.
9.4: 'Cause if some Macedonians pull up with me and y'all ain't got it together? That'd be mad embarrassing—for y'all and me.
9.5: So I told the crew to go ahead of time and help y'all get the gift ready. You already said you was givin'—so I want it to come from a place of generosity, not like you got forced into it.
9.6: Let me give y'all this truth: whoever plants a little, reaps a little. But if you plant a lot, you gon' reap a lot too.
9.7: So everybody should give what they feel in their heart to give—not outta guilt or pressure—'cause God loves a cheerful giver.
9.8: And trust—God can make all grace overflow toward you. You'll always have enough, and then some, to do every good work.
9.9: Just like it's written: "He gave freely to the poor; His righteousness lasts forever."
9.10: And the same God who gives seed to the sower and bread for food? He gon' bless the seed you sow and multiply it. He gon' grow that harvest of righteousness in your life.
9.11: He'll make sure you got more than enough, so you can keep bein' generous. And all that generosity? Leads to people thankin' God.
9.12: This offering you puttin' together? It's doin' two things: Helpin' out the saints who need it and overflowin' with praise to God.
9.13: Your generosity proves that your faith ain't just talk. Folks gon' glorify God because y'all walkin' out the gospel for real—and y'all sharin' with them and everybody else.
9.14: And they gon' be prayin' for y'all too, thankin' God for the grace they see workin' through you.
9.15: Thanks be to God for His gift—too good for words to even describe.

10.1: Look—it's me, Paul. I'm comin' to y'all humble, just like Christ was—gentle and meek. Yeah, I may seem soft when I'm around y'all, but when I ain't there, I get real bold.
10.2: But I'm askin' y'all—please don't make me have to come in hot. Don't test me to come bold like I plan to be with some folks who act like we out here wildin' in the flesh.
10.3: Yeah, we live in this fleshly body—but the fight we in? Ain't a fleshly one.
10.4: Our weapons ain't physical. They spiritual and powerful, built to tear down strongholds,
10.5: break down false arguments, and destroy any high-minded mess that sets itself up against the knowledge of God. We bring every thought into check, makin' it submit to Christ.
10.6: And trust—we ready to handle disobedience. But we waitin' until y'all fully walkin' in obedience first.
10.7: Y'all stay focused on what things look like on the outside. But if anybody out here think they belong to Christ, they need to remember—we belong to Him too.
10.8: I ain't scared to talk about the authority God gave me. He didn't give it to me to tear y'all down—but to build y'all up. And I ain't ashamed of that.
10.9: I ain't tryna scare you with these letters.
10.10: I know folks be sayin': "His letters hit hard, but in person he weak, and his talk ain't impressive."
10.11: Well, whoever sayin' that better know—what I write when I'm away is what I'll be about when I show up.
10.12: We ain't out here comparin' ourselves to these folks who gas themselves up. That ain't wisdom. They out here makin' themselves the standard, then tryna measure up to they own hype.
10.13: Nah, we stay in our lane—the lane God gave us. And that lane includes y'all.
10.14: We ain't doin' too much—we brought the gospel straight to y'all. That was part of our mission from jump.
10.15: We not claimin' credit for work other folks did. We just hopin' that as your faith grows, our reach grows too—right along with y'all.
10.16: We tryna take this gospel beyond y'all, to places where folks ain't heard it yet. We ain't tryna ride off somebody else's wave.
10.17: Like Scripture says: "If you gon' brag, brag on the Lord."
10.18: 'Cause at the end of the day, it ain't about who hypin' themselves up—it's about who God approves.

11.1: I wish y'all would let me vent a lil' bit—even if it sound foolish. But I know y'all rockin' with me.
11.2: I'm jealous for y'all—with God-level jealousy. I promised y'all to one Man—Christ—and I been tryna keep y'all pure for Him.
11.3: But I'm worried… just like Eve got played by the serpent, some slick talk might be gettin' to your mind and pullin' you away from the simple truth in Christ.
11.4: 'Cause real talk—if somebody comes preachin' another Jesus, or bringin' a different spirit or new gospel than the one y'all first heard—y'all just might go for it.
11.5: Let me be clear—I'm not less than these so-called "super-apostles."
11.6: I might not speak fancy, but I know what I'm talkin' about. And y'all done seen that firsthand.
11.7: Did I mess up by humbling myself so you could be lifted up? I gave y'all the gospel for free.
11.8: I took support from other churches just to serve y'all.
11.9: When I was in need, I didn't burden y'all—folks from Macedonia came through and helped. I made sure I wouldn't be a burden, and I'm still standin' on that.
11.10: As long as I got breath and truth in me, nobody in Achaia gon' shut me up from speakin' on this.
11.11: Why? You think it's 'cause I don't love y'all? God knows I do.
11.12: I'm gon' keep doin' what I'm doin'—so I can shut down these folks who want to look like they movin' like we are.
11.13: They fake apostles, shady workers, dressin' up like they really reppin' Christ.
11.14: And it ain't no surprise—Satan himself be dressin' like an angel of light.
11.15: So of course his people gon' try and act righteous. But in the end? They gon' get what they earned.
11.16: Let me say it again—don't think I'm a fool. But if you do, at least let me flex a lil' bit.
11.17: I'm talkin' real loose here—not on God's behalf—but since everybody else out here braggin', let me get mine off too.
11.18: Y'all love hearin' folks brag in the flesh, so I'mma speak y'all language for a sec.
11.19: Y'all be dealin' with fools like it's cute—'cause y'all think y'all so wise.
11.20: You let folks control you, take from you, lift themselves up, even disrespect you—and y'all eatin' it up.
11.21: And I'm ashamed to say—I ain't actin' like that. But if we talkin' bold, I'll go there too (even if it sound foolish).
11.22: They say they Hebrew? So am I. They Israelites? Me too. They Abraham's kids? Same here.
11.23: They say they serve Christ? I'mma say it like a fool—I done done more: Worked more, Got beat more, Jailed more, Faced death over and over.
11.24: Five times I got whipped—forty lashes minus one.
11.25: Three times beat with rods. One time stoned. Three times shipwrecked. I spent a whole night and day floating in open water.
11.26: I been through it, y'all: Dangerous trips, Robbers, Haters from my own people, Haters from outsiders, City drama, Wilderness traps, Sea storms, Snakes wearin' church clothes (fake believers).
11.27: Tired, grindin', missin' sleep. Hungry, thirsty. Fasting. Cold. Barely clothed.
11.28: And on top of all that? I'm constantly carryin' the weight of every single church I planted.
11.29: When one of y'all weak—I feel that. When somebody fall—I burn with concern.
11.30: If I gotta brag, I'ma brag about what exposes my weakness.
11.31: God—the Father of Jesus Christ, who's blessed forever—knows I ain't lyin'.
11.32: In Damascus, the governor had guards posted tryna catch me.
11.33: But I got outta there—they let me down in a basket through a window in the wall. That's how I escaped.

12.1: Look—I know braggin' don't help, but lemme go ahead and talk about these visions and revelations from the Lord.
12.2: I know a man in Christ (talkin' about myself here)—this was like 14 years ago—don't know if it was a physical experience or spiritual, but God knows—he got caught up to the third heaven.
12.3: Yeah, I said it again—whether it was in the body or not, I don't know—but God knows.
12.4: This man (still me) got caught up into Paradise—heard stuff so deep, it ain't even lawful for a man to repeat it.
12.5: I'll brag on that experience—but me, personally? I'll only boast about my weaknesses.
12.6: I could flex if I wanted to—it'd be true—but I don't wanna hype myself up beyond what y'all have actually seen or heard from me.
12.7: But to keep me from gettin' big-headed from all these crazy revelations, God gave me a thorn in my flesh—a messenger from Satan sent to bother me and keep me grounded.
12.8: I prayed about it—three times—beggin' God to take it away.
12.9: But He told me: "My grace is enough for you. My strength shows up best when you weak." So now I'm like—I'll gladly boast about my struggles, so Christ's power can show up in my life.
12.10: That's why I take joy in hard times, disrespect, lack, hate, and pressure—if it's for Christ, then when I'm weak, I'm really strong.
12.11: I know—I sound crazy braggin' like this. But y'all made me go here. Y'all shoulda been speakin' up for me instead. I may not be nothin' by the world's standards, but I ain't behind none of them "super-apostles."
12.12: Y'all saw the proof of my apostleship—through miracles, signs, and real perseverance.
12.13: Only thing y'all missed out on was me not takin' anything from you—and if that was wrong, then forgive me, I guess.
12.14: Look, this my third time gettin' ready to come visit—and I still won't be a burden. I ain't after your stuff—I'm after y'all. It ain't the kids' job to save up for the parents—it's the parents for the kids.
12.15: And I'll gladly give everything I got for y'all—even if the more I love you, the less y'all love me back.
12.16: But fine, say what you want—I didn't burden y'all. Still, some folks say I was slick with it and trapped y'all.
12.17: But did I take advantage of you through anyone I sent?
12.18: I told Titus to come, and sent someone with him. Did Titus take advantage of y'all? Didn't we both walk the same way, in the same spirit?
12.19: Y'all think we just out here defending ourselves? Nah—we speak before God, in Christ. And everything we've done? It's for y'all's growth.
12.20: But I'm nervous. I'm scared that when I show up, I won't find y'all in a good place—and y'all won't like how I come either. I'm talkin' about: Arguments, Jealousy, Angry outbursts, Selfishness, Gossip, Shadiness, Pride, Drama.
12.21: I don't wanna come and end up grievin'—mournin' over folks who sinned and never turned from it. I'm talkin' about that uncleanness, sexual sin, and straight-up wild behavior that some still ain't repented from.

13.1: Aight—this the third time I'm comin' to y'all. And just like Scripture says: "Every matter should be confirmed by two or three witnesses."
13.2: I already warned y'all before, and now I'm sayin' it again like I'm there now—if I pull up and folks still wildin'? I ain't holdin' back.
13.3: Y'all been lookin' for proof that Christ really speaks through me? Bet. He ain't weak when it comes to y'all—He strong, and that strength shows up in y'all too.
13.4: Yeah, He got crucified in weakness—but now He lives in the power of God. Same way—we weak in Him, but we gon' live in that same power toward y'all.
13.5: Check yourself. See if you really in the faith. Test yourself. Don't you realize Jesus Christ lives inside you? Unless—you ain't passin' the test.
13.6: But I'm trustin' you gon' see that we passed the test, and we ain't fake.
13.7: I'm prayin' to God that y'all do what's right—not so we look good, but so you can walk with integrity—even if folks think we ain't legit.
13.8: We can't do nothin' against the truth—only for the truth.
13.9: And look—we cool with bein' weak if it means y'all strong. That's our prayer: that y'all grow, mature, and be made whole.
13.10: That's why I'm writin' this now, while I'm gone—so I don't have to come in hot when I arrive. 'Cause the authority God gave me? It's for building y'all up, not tearing y'all down.
13.11: Alright family, for real—take care. Grow into who God called you to be. Encourage each other. Stay united. Live in peace. And the God of love and peace? He gon' be with y'all.
13.12: Greet each other with that holy kiss (y'all know what it is—real love, no shade).
13.13: All the saints send their love to y'all.
13.14: And this is my final prayer for you: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with every one of y'all. Amen.
